criteria.name: Major
criteria.description: Agent A makes a claim “c” to Agent B

criteria.name: Minor 2
criteria.description: Omission of “o” benefits Agent A if B accepts “c” as sufficient

criteria.name: Conclusion
criteria.description: Claim “c” should be scrutinised for concealment of information

criteria.name: CQ1
criteria.description: What information might have been omitted in “c”?

criteria.name: CQ2
criteria.description: How would B's beliefs or actions change if “o” were disclosed?

criteria.name: CQ3
criteria.description: Does A have a history of selective omission?

criteria.name: CQ4
criteria.description: What benefits does A gain from concealing “o”?

criteria.name: CQ5
criteria.description: Is there independent evidence supporting or contradicting the omission?
